title: Backend Developer (Node.js, TypeScript)
description:
Employment type: FULL_TIME, CONTRACTOR
Applicants must be located in: Poland
Szukamy osoby na stanowisko Backend Developer do Staffly — rozwijamy platformę HR Tech, z której korzysta już ponad 300 firm w regionie CEE. Nasz produkt automatyzuje rekrutację i preselekcję kandydatów przy użyciu autorskich narzędzi psychometrycznych.
Działamy od 2021 roku, pozyskaliśmy prawie 5 mln PLN od funduszy VC (Deloitte Fast 50 „Company to Watch”), a teraz wchodzimy na kolejne rynki UE. Rozbudowujemy nasz zespół inżynieryjny, więc będziesz mieć realny wpływ na architekturę i nowe funkcjonalności platformy.
Jak pracujemy?
Model pracy: Działamy w pełni zdalnie, a osoby z Poznania/Warszawy i okolic zapraszamy również do biura (model hybrydowy).

Narzędzia: Projekty i dokumentację prowadzimy w Jira oraz Confluence.

Podejście do AI: Stawiamy na odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie AI w programowaniu, kładąc nacisk na jakość, bezpieczeństwo i stabilność kodu.

Czego szukamy:
Samodzielność oparta na jasnych założeniach – zanim napiszesz kod, aktywnie uczestniczysz w analizie wymagań. Pracujesz w zespole i samodzielnie pozyskujesz potrzebne informacje.

Dbałość o jakość, wydajność i bezpieczeństwo – testy, czytelny kod i przemyślane zapytania to dla Ciebie standard. Pracujemy na danych wrażliwych kandydatów, dlatego bezpieczeństwo jest u nas priorytetem (security by design).

Odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie AI w SDLC – korzystasz z AI na każdym etapie tworzenia oprogramowania, krytycznie weryfikując jego wyniki. Chcesz współtworzyć nasz proces wytwarzania oprogramowania wspierany AI.

Gotowość do działań DevOps – chcesz sprawnie wdrażać zmiany i dbać o stabilność systemu na środowisku produkcyjnym.

Cechy, które u nas się sprawdzają:
Odpowiedzialność i uczciwość — mówisz otwarcie, gdy coś nie działa albo czegoś nie wiesz, i doprowadzasz sprawy do końca.

Proaktywność i odwaga — zadajesz trudne pytania, proponujesz zmiany i nie czekasz, aż ktoś przydzieli Ci problem.

Kreatywność i otwartość — szukasz lepszych rozwiązań, chętnie testujesz nowe narzędzia i przyjmujesz feedback.

Analityczne myślenie i dokładność — zanim coś zmienisz, rozumiesz dlaczego; dbasz o szczegóły, bo pracujemy na wrażliwych danych.

Komunikatywność — jasno przekazujesz informacje zarówno na piśmie, jak i na rozmowach głosowych; w pracy zdalnej to podstawa.

Obowiązki
Doprecyzowanie wymagań z zespołem przed implementacją: pytania, założenia, potwierdzony zakres i kryteria akceptacji

Projektowanie i implementacja API w NestJS (kontrolery, serwisy, DTO, walidacja, dokumentacja)

Modelowanie danych w MongoDB (Mongoose / Typegoose), optymalizacja zapytań i indeksów

Integracje z systemami partnerów i klientów

Przetwarzanie asynchroniczne: Redis, Azure Service Bus, zadania cron

Dbanie o jakość: testy jednostkowe i e2e, code review, SonarQube

Rozwój procesu SDLC wspieranego AI: agenci, skills, automatyzacja

Wdrożenia i utrzymanie: CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines), Docker, Kubernetes na Azure, monitoring i obsługa incydentów (Datadog)

Wymagania obowiązkowe
Min. 4 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia z Node.js i TypeScript (mid); 7+ lat (senior)

Min. 3 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia z Next.js

Praktyczna znajomość NestJS i projektowania REST API (uwierzytelnianie JWT, kontrola dostępu)

Doświadczenie z MongoDB i Mongoose: schematy, agregacje, indeksy

Testy automatyczne jako codzienna praktyka (Jest, testy integracyjne)

Bezpieczeństwo: OWASP Top 10, RODO, ochrona danych wrażliwych

Codzienna praca z asystentami AI do kodowania (np. Claude Code) z krytyczną weryfikacją wyników

Docker, Git i praca w procesie code review

Mile widziane
DevOps — doświadczenie we wdrażaniu aplikacji na Kubernetes (AKS), zarządzaniu sekretami w Azure Key Vault i plikami w Blob Storage oraz w budowie pipeline’ów CI/CD od zera.

Wydajność — optymalizacja wolnych zapytań, wprowadzanie cache i paginacji oraz obsługa limitów zewnętrznych API przy dużym ruchu.

Przetwarzanie asynchroniczne — budowa kolejek zadań (Bull + Redis, Azure Service Bus lub inny message broker), np. do masowej wysyłki powiadomień czy przetwarzania wyników w tle.

Narzędzia AI dla zespołu — tworzenie workflow agentowych, serwerów MCP lub skilli, które realnie przyspieszają pracę zespołu, albo rozwój takich projektów open source.

LLM w produkcie — wdrażanie funkcji opartych na LLM: projektowanie promptów, korzystanie ze structured output oraz kontrola kosztów i limitów.

Szyfrowanie danych — szyfrowanie danych wrażliwych na poziomie aplikacji, np. danych osobowych lub wyników testów.

Komunikacja z użytkownikami — generowanie raportów PDF z szablonów (EJS, Handlebars) oraz budowa wysyłki e-mail / SMS w produkcie.

Branża — doświadczenie przy produkcie HR-tech lub SaaS B2B i znajomość współpracy z klientem biznesowym.

Może szukamy właśnie Ciebie? Sprawdź!

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Vue.js + PHP)
description:
Employment type: FULL_TIME, CONTRACTOR
Applicants must be located in: Poland
Prodio — prosty program do zarządzania produkcją, z którego codziennie korzystają tysiące na halach produkcyjnych w Polsce i na świecie.
Stolarnie, tokarnie, narzędziownie, drukarnie, palarnie kawy — ponad 200 małych firm produkcyjnych odpala rano Prodio, żeby wiedzieć co robić, na jakiej maszynie i dla kogo. Pracownik na hali przykłada brelok RFID, klika start i robi swoją robotę. Szef widzi postępy na żywo, bez dzwonienia i karteczek. Byliśmy jednymi z pierwszych, którzy zrobili to w pełni online, prosto i ładnie — bez ERP-owej złożoności za dziesiątki tysięcy złotych.
Dlaczego warto:
🧑‍💻 Masz swój obszar, za który odpowiadasz i w którym sam podejmujesz decyzje.
Nowe moduły aplikacji i te, które przebudowujesz, są Twoje. Dobierasz architekturę i narzędzia, ustalasz standard kodu i testów, optymalizujesz, wypuszczasz zmiany na produkcję i odpowiadasz, gdy coś się psuje.
🏭 Budujesz coś, z czego prawdziwi ludzie korzystają każdego dnia.
Nie kolejny dashboard, którego nikt nie ogląda. Twój kod będzie na tysiącach ekranów małych firm produkcyjnych. Każdą zmianę, na dobre i na złe, od razu oceni pani Basia z biura i pan Zbyszek, który o 6:00 loguje się przy swojej maszynie.
🔧 Legacy, które bierzesz na siebie.
Kod rósł latami razem z nowymi funkcjami dla Klientów. Moduły, które przebudowujesz, bierzesz w swoje ręce: refaktorujesz, optymalizujesz, dokładasz testy, poprawiasz architekturę. Masz wolną rękę i pełną odpowiedzialność.
🚀 Wprowadzasz więcej życia w produkcie.
Mamy roadmapę pełną rzeczy, na które klienci naprawdę czekają. Z doświadczeniem od 2017 roku i z możliwościami, jakie daje AI, chcemy zrobić najlepsze narzędzie w tej niszy na świecie.

Czym będziesz się zajmować:
Nowe moduły i funkcje, od endpointów po interfejs, na podstawie prototypów:
przeniesienie ostatnich ekranów aplikacji do Vue.js, z nowymi funkcjami,

rozbudowany scheduler: oś czasu, maszyny, przeciąganie zleceń, setki elementów bez lagu,

nowy widok rejestracji produkcji i komunikacji z halą dla pracowników, wraz z backendem,

moduły graficzne do zarządzania technologią produktu i analizy wykonania,

asystent AI w aplikacji: interfejs na naszym nowym API,

rozbudowa i przebudowa modułu magazynu.

Wydajność, architektura, testy automatyczne i przejście na nowsze wersje frameworków.

Poprawianie i ulepszanie istniejących ekranów, wizualnie i funkcjonalnie.

Frontend (Vue.js 2 / Quasar / TypeScript) i backend (PHP / Yii2), około 75% front, 25% back.

Kogo szukamy:
Masz co najmniej 6 lat doświadczenia, w tym minimum 2 lata na samodzielnym stanowisku w jednej firmie (z odpowiedzialnością za front produktu od kodu do produkcji: wydania, poprawki i to, co się psuło).

Znasz bardzo dobrze Vue 2, Vue 3 i TypeScript. W PHP samodzielnie piszesz endpointy (komercyjny backend to atut).

Nie boisz się legacy kodu i wprowadzałeś/aś testy automatyczne oraz standardy tam, gdzie wcześniej ich nie było.

Zbudowałeś/aś złożony, interaktywny interfejs na danych: planer, kalendarz, board z drag & drop.

Pracujesz świadomie z AI: wiesz, jak sprawdzać wynik, a nie tylko jak go generować.

Nie aplikuj jeśli:
legacy kod Cię przeraża — większość naszej aplikacji ma wiele lat,

wolisz dostawać zadania rozpisane w tickety i oddawać je komuś do wdrożenia,

szukasz roli menedżerskiej albo projektanta UX,

szukasz dużego zespołu z masą spotkań i sprintów,

chcesz przepisać wszystko od nowa na Reacta z pomocą AI

Stack:
Vue.js 2, Quasar v1, TypeScript, PHP, Yii2, MariaDB, REST API, socket.io, Kubernetes

What you’ll do
Lead front-end development for top-tier eCommerce projects and be the person the client talks to: weekly calls, agreeing on priorities, explaining your choices

Work closely with a PM who keeps the project organized, so you can focus on hands-on work. Collaborate with designers and other devs to turn ideas into high-performing storefronts

Write clean, reliable code that is ready for production

Make key technical and architectural decisions, and explain why you made them

Own the whole project, not just your own tasks: scope, risks, delivery and the result for the client

Continuously push for better engineering practices and scalable solutions

Contribute to internal standards, tooling, and AI-assisted workflows, and help the team find where AI really saves time

Mentor other developers and promote best practices

Who you are and what we are looking for
A senior engineer with 5+ years in JavaScript/TypeScript, ideally React / Next.js / React-Router or a similar framework

You have worked with clients from the outside, not as part of their team (agency, consultancy, freelance). This is a must

You’ve led production projects or small teams before. You know how to ship

You value pragmatic engineering. You focus on what works and scales, not over-engineering

You care about both the craft and the outcome: elegant solutions that drive real business results, with an eye for polish, UX, and performance

You enjoy working in small, dedicated teams and take ownership of the whole project, not just your task

You use AI tools every day and know where they help and where they don’t

Comfortable managing multiple shifting priorities with support from PM and engineering managers

Strong communication: you can discuss trade-offs with clients and teammates. Fluent English (for client work) and at least B2 Polish

Bonus: experience with headless commerce (Shopify, Commerce Layer, etc.)

What it’s really like to work here
At Commerce-UI, we trust each other’s judgment and take pride in our craft. Everyone here owns their work, not because someone expects it, but because we care about what we build and who we build it with.
Owning a project means knowing it end to end and being the partner the client calls when something matters. You’re not part of their team and you don’t just take tickets. If you’ve only worked inside a client’s organisation, it can be a big step, and we’d rather say so upfront.
You won’t carry it alone: a project manager keeps planning, priorities and client logistics in order, so you can stay hands-on with the code.
We take AI seriously and use it on purpose. It already saves us time, and our last hackathon was all about it.
We work fast, with real autonomy from day one, no layers of management or rigid playbooks, and a lot of trust that everyone knows what they’re doing. If that sounds like you, you’ll feel right at home.

Why you’ll love working here
Small, senior, passionate team - no bureaucracy, real impact

Work on ambitious, design-led projects for global brands

Freedom to shape how we build things

Competitive pay and flexible, remote-friendly culture

Shopify Hydrogen (React-Router 7/Remix) or Next.js

Oxygen, Vercel, Cloudlfare

Typescript (always)

CSS, Sass, CSS Modules, Stitches, Vanilla extract

Toolkit
Cursor, Webstorm

ChatGPT

Google Workspace

Jira

Notion

Loom

Team
Most of the time, you’ll collaborate closely with:
Tomek and Kuba - Engineering Managers

Robert - Head of Project Management

Michał - Co-Founder & CTO

Szymon - Co-Founder

How our hiring process looks like?
Application → send us your CV and any link/portfolio that show your craft. We review every application and always get back to you - regardless of the outcome.

Discovery call → this is short (30 minutes) mutual check-in - we want to understand your expectations and share ours. We will talk in Polish, and English.

Task → a short focused task based on the kind of work we actually do. ~2 hours with clear instructions. We respect your time.

Tech call → a deep dive into how you think and solve problems. You’ll chat with Kuba or Tom (our Engineering Managers) - no trick questions, just real talk about tech and delivery.

Offer → if it’s a match, we’ll schedule a short call (20-30 minutes) to go over the details and next steps. If we don’t move forward we’ll do our best to give you thoughtful feedback.

Since we’re remote, we don’t offer free snacks or bean bags, but we do provide flexible work arrangements, a healthy work-life balance, and a friendly company culture. Every Thursday, we have 'Elevenses,' where anyone can join a video call to catch up, share stories, or play games. It helps us stay connected.

About the role

Enjoy the freedom of remote work while playing a key role in shaping the tools that thousands of brokers and insurers rely on. By enhancing our front-end, you'll improve user interfaces that empower professionals to manage schemes more efficiently and provide excellent service to their clients, all from the comfort of your home.

If you're a passionate Front-end Developer in the UK who knows React.js and modern front-end tools, this opportunity could be an excellent fit for you.

We’re looking for someone ready to jump in and focus on building user interfaces as part of one of our product teams. Within 6 to 12 months, you’ll help build and modernise core parts of SchemeServe, significantly enhancing our clients' workflow and efficiency. You’ll use React.js, TypeScript, and CSS (including Tailwind CSS) to create reliable, maintainable products. If you’ve done this before and enjoy it, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll primarily work with a product team in an agile manner, which includes back-end and QA engineers, as well as UX designers, a product manager, and an engineering manager. Sometimes, you may also join other front-end projects, so strong communication and people skills are essential.

Front-End Developer Responsibilities:

Developing new and existing features/ interfaces to enhance the user experience.
Building reusable components and front-end libraries for future use.
Translating designs and wireframes into high-quality code.
Optimising components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers.
Maximise pages for speed and scalability.
Accurately translate user and business needs into functional frontend code.
Liaising with internal & external stakeholders through the life cycle of each project.
Maintaining brand consistency throughout the implementation of designs.

UK-based: Your presence in the UK helps with tax and data rules, ensuring smooth operations and compliance.
6+ years of experience in front-end development.
3+ years of experience using React.
Understanding of key design principles.
Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
Good problem-solving skills demonstrated by delivering solutions to complex challenges.
Excellent verbal communication skills to collaborate with diverse teams.
Good interpersonal skills to foster a positive team environment.
Experience working in an agile development process.
Be open to feedback and constructive criticism, and be happy to work collaboratively to improve.

Interview Process

Experience an interview process designed with collaboration and appreciation at its core. This is your opportunity to showcase how your skills align with what we need, in an environment of mutual respect and partnership.

You’ll initially meet your potential future manager along with the Principal of Frontend in a 30-60 minute cultural interview, where both parties can discuss values and work styles openly.

We offer a short take-home tech test that allows you to demonstrate your coding skills. This is your chance to present your thought process, leading into a tech interview where we explore your solutions collaboratively.

Finally, during an hour-long tech interview, we take a deeper dive into your technical expertise. This session is an exploration of your approach and how it fits with our technological challenge.

Internal Ingestion

External Ingestion

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka [truncated]

title: Feltsense AI Engineer
description:
About the company
We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.
We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.
Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.
Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role
We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.
You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.
You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities
Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements
4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have
Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.
